notes: Native messaging now keeps one persistent stdin/stdout pair, preventing stream disposal and intermittent bridge failures
HTTP Origin and Cookie headers are combined into one FFmpeg header block for better compatibility
Quality probing now uses ffprobe and returns resolution, codec, FPS, bitrate and stream index
FFmpeg recovery keeps conservative profiles and exposes the real rejected option/diagnostic instead of only the last error line
Automatic updater now stages and verifies the extension before replacement, backs up native binaries, rolls back on failure, and cleans older backups
Extension automatically checks every 6 hours and reloads only after the updater reports a verified successful installation
